predictor.definition: each body held at its time-mean position over the window

comparisons.initial_state: the train record's first in-window snapshot (true_r0, true_v0)

context.note: the probe's reproduction branch is recorded, not required; the smoke proves mechanics and cost only

orbit.two_kepler_initial_state: the train record's first in-window snapshot (true_r0, true_v0)

window.basis: physical times of the training samples

first_layer_frequency.definition: abs(input_layer.weight[:, 0]) * omega_0 / pi, cycles across the full normalized tau window

entries.frequency_reason: not applicable: abs(input_layer.weight[:, 0]) * omega_0 / pi describes only the raw tau column of the first layer's weights, and the encoded input's time signal also spans the appended harmonic sin/cos features, so no single aggregate bandwidth describes the complete encoded input; the encoder's pinned per-harmonic physical frequencies are recorded instead

output_movement.definition: centered output norm / centered gold norm

output_rate_ratio.definition: RMS network autograd d/dtau over RMS torch.gradient gold d/dtau, both in normalized tau

physical_dt_median.definition: median physical spacing of adjacent samples
physical_dt_median.note: physical time spacing; not normalized-tau spacing

timing.basis: optimizer steps only (constant-rate Adam), synchronized completed-work segments: the first 200 updates are warmup and the remaining 112500 provide the optimizer-rate measurement; similarity logging, frozen scoring, comparisons and artifact writes excluded; monotonic clock
timing.seconds_per_step_basis: sum of the measured synchronized update durations divided by the 112500 measured steps; excludes the 200 warmup updates, similarity logging, scoring and artifact writes; a 112500-step sample is not steady-state throughput for other configurations
